description: Join us at Union Hill Cider Co. Saturday August 29th from 6-7:30pm to hear from John Duresky, candidate for Washington’s 4th congressional district. Discuss the issues important to you and meet other local voters to get involved!

title: East Wenatchee Town Hall — JOHN DURESKY FOR CONGRESS
